set.pl: Old Maxwell place, ~35 acres, N sec 30 T90N R1E, E edge of Rickardsville (1906 plat)
pinev: 1906 Dubuque Co plat, Jefferson Twp p. 9 (Ancestry image 31617_072142-00253): 'Maxwell', about 35 acres in the N part of sec 30 T90N R1E, immediately E of the Rickardsville village plat (BLM sec 30 = 42.5723-42.5869, -90.8978..-90.8781). Pin still on GNIS Rickardsville pending a check of which side of the village the tract lies.
1915 Iowa census: John Datisman, 65, farmer, Jefferson Twp, P.O. Durango RFD, owns $9,000; on the 1906 plate he is in sec 35 by Durango, so he held the Maxwell place by 1915.

src: Dubuque County plat (1906), Jefferson Twp p. 9 (Ancestry image 31617_072142-00253)
